_comment: 13.6 TeV xsecs [pb] for the Zb_Zc_ratio Run 3 run (all four campaigns; same generators and energy). DY: as metadata/Zb_Zc_ratio_xsections_Summer22.json (inclusive MLL-50 from helpers/xsection.py; PTLL-X = inclusive x signed fraction of inclusive events with LHE_Vpt > X, measured on Summer22). TTto2L2Nu: NNLO, helpers/xsection.py. WW/WZ/ZZ: TOP-22-012 values from helpers/xsection.py (the higher-order numbers, not the LO GenXSecAnalyzer ones). Normalize as xsec * lumi[channel] / sumw; lumi per campaign and channel from hists_zbzc_run3/<campaign>/lumi.json.
